dialogue.speaker: Dolores Marrow
dialogue.text: They called my case. Below, obviously. Thirty years of watered-down whiskey adds up.

dialogue.speaker: Dolores Marrow
dialogue.text: But I'm leaving with a friend, which is more than I thought I'd get. Don't tell anyone I said that.

dialogue.speaker: Dolores Marrow
dialogue.text: [She slides a single bottle across the bar. It's the good stuff. She never poured this for anyone.]
